summary: Flux Power Holdings filed an 8-K reporting Amendment No. 7 to its July 28, 2023 Loan and Security Agreement with Gibraltar Business Capital, effective September 17, 2026. The amendment adds a covenant requiring the Company to complete an equity sale yielding at least $4.0 million in net proceeds within 50 days, mandates budget and compliance reporting with material deviations triggering an immediate event of default, and requires amending the EBITDA minimum covenant within 90 days. A $135,000 amendment fee is payable in three installments. The Company remains in default; GBC reserved remedies. Watch for the equity raise and forbearance risk.
